Board-Setup Manufacturing Defaults

`/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro` and `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` form a loadable KiCad 9 PCB worksheet project. The board already contains two routed rails, board-outline graphics, a fabrication note, and a courtyard guide. Its current board-setup defaults were copied from an overly coarse template. `/home/user/Desktop/fab_setup.json` lists the routing minima and default drawing/text settings that the fabrication team expects.

Open the board project in KiCad PCB Editor, use Board Setup to apply the target values from `/home/user/Desktop/fab_setup.json`, and save the project without changing the worksheet board geometry or routed items.

Requirements:
1. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`: `board.design_settings.rules` must match the routing minima in `/home/user/Desktop/fab_setup.json`.
2. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro`: `board.design_settings.defaults` must match the silkscreen, fabrication-text, and courtyard settings in `/home/user/Desktop/fab_setup.json`.
3. `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` must remain a loadable copy of the worksheet board, preserving its outline, two routed rails, fabrication note, and courtyard guide.
4. No project changes outside `board.design_settings.rules` and `board.design_settings.defaults` are allowed.

Write `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro` and `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb`.
